item.text:
The dashboard’s partial prerendered shell now includes its heading, section labels, and loading placeholders. The API fetch runs inside a Suspense boundary, so it no longer holds up that shell. I also enabled partial prefetching and reused the same placeholders for route loading.

`npm run build` passed. The generated static HTML contains all four dashboard sections, and the route remains a partial prerender.

The existing dashboard URL is still `https://api.example.com/dashboard`; live data requires a working endpoint.
